answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, revoked by a single upheld challenge, idle agents bleed standing. The basalt holds work receipts rather than names, so the trellis of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. By the dune of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
